线性增减场景总进光量 (EV): Scale the scene's total light linearly (EV)
自动曝光（AU）：按 18% 中灰测光建议设置曝光，不改动其他参数: Auto exposure (AU): apply the 18% grey metering suggestion to exposure only
高光强光区域场景线性滚降压缩或提亮: Compress (roll off) or lift the highlight region in scene-linear
深层暗部阶调平滑提亮或下压，保护纯黑底阶: Lift or deepen the deep-shadow tones while keeping true black
黑场标定：向左扣除片基灰雾、压实纯黑，向右抬高黑位。作用在 LUT 之后的显示域: Black-point calibration: left removes base fog and crushes to true black, right raises the black level. Applied in display space, after the LUT.
调节场景相关色温 (CCT)，左偏冷蓝，右偏暖黄: Scene correlated colour temperature (CCT); left is cooler, right is warmer
微调洋红与绿色光色平衡 (Tint)，左偏品红，右偏绿色: Fine-tune the magenta/green balance; left is magenta, right is green
底片画幅尺寸，影响银盐晶体与微米级弥散圈物理相对尺度: Negative format size; sets the physical scale of the silver crystals and the micron-level circle of confusion
开启后性能会下降，但预览会更准: Slower, but the preview matches the export
视口色彩管理（按显示器 profile 校正颜色）: Viewport colour management (correct with the display profile)
开启后视口按当前显示器的 ICC 输出，广色域屏上不再偏艳；\n关闭则固定按 s: The viewport is converted to the current display's ICC profile, so wide-gamut screens no longer look over-saturated; turn this off to always output sRGB (as older builds did). Ignored when Windows auto colour management (ACM) is on.
界面文字大小（只影响字号，不改变控件与间距）: Text size (font size only, control sizes and spacing stay put)
界面语言（切换后需重启软件生效）: Interface language (takes effect after a restart)
原生卷（spektrafilm 链）的默认相纸：新导入的底片与未手动选过相纸的底: Default paper for native stocks (spektrafilm chain): used by newly imported photos and by photos that have no paper picked yet (thumbnails follow). "Direct scan" shows the un-inverted negative first.
转换卷（fotufilm 点式链，含 CineStill / UltraMax: Default paper for converted stocks (fotufilm point chain — CineStill, UltraMax, …): only papers that chain actually has tables for are listed
启动时打开上次工程: Open the last session on startup
从 Adobe Camera Raw 克隆镜头库到本地用户目录（%APPDATA: Clone Adobe Camera Raw's lens library into the local user folder (%APPDATA%\SpektraDarkroom\LensProfiles)
在资源管理器中打开镜头配置目录: Open the lens profile folder in Explorer
恢复为系统默认缓存目录 (%LOCALAPPDATA%/SpektraDarkr: Restore the system default cache folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%/SpektraDarkroom)
清除注册表中的 .sdss 文件关联: Remove the .sdss association from the registry
关联 .sdss 文件，支持双击直接打开: Associate .sdss files so a double-click opens them here
导入镜头库失败: Could not import the lens library
界面语言已保存，重启软件后生效。: Language saved. Restart the app to apply it.
无法读取显示器 profile（{err}）: Could not read the display profile ({err})
开启后将从导出文件的 EXIF 元数据中完全抹除 GPS 经纬度与海拔坐标，保留: Removes GPS coordinates and altitude from the exported EXIF entirely, keeping camera, lens, aperture, shutter and capture time.
替换重名文件: Overwrite files with the same name
勾选时同目录同名文件直接覆盖；取消勾选则自动改名为 xxx_1、xxx_2 等，: When checked, a file with the same name in the folder is overwritten; unchecked it is renamed to xxx_1, xxx_2 and the original is kept.
JPEG 画质档位 1–10，数字越大画质越高、体积越大: JPEG quality 1–10: higher means better image and larger file
渐进式 JPEG 在下载过程中由模糊到清晰，文件体积略大: Progressive JPEG renders blurry-then-sharp while loading; the file is slightly larger
留空则使用原文件名: Leave empty to keep the original name
扩展名随格式自动修正: The extension follows the chosen format
留空则保持原文件名输出: Leave empty to keep the original name
取消所有排队中与正在扫描的任务: Cancel every queued and running task
从列表中清除已完成或已取消的历史任务: Remove finished or cancelled tasks from the list
视口会显示「导出成这个色彩空间」的样子: The viewport shows what exporting to this colour space looks like
校样关闭时，视口按显示器 profile 直接显示。: With proofing off, the viewport follows the display profile directly.
sRGB 是最常见的交付目标；超出它的颜色会被夹到边界（相对比色）。: sRGB is the most common delivery target; colours outside it are clipped (relative colorimetric).
「{target}」色域之外的像素会被夹到边界。与导出该色彩空间用的是同一组矩阵: Pixels outside the “{target}” gamut are clipped at the boundary. The same matrices are used for export, so what you see is what you get.
确定要将底片文件 “{name}” 移至回收站吗？\n此操作将从磁盘中删除该文件:
Move “{name}” to the Recycle Bin?
This removes the file from disk and from the library.
确定要将选中的 {n} 个底片文件移至回收站吗？\n此操作将从磁盘中删除这些文件:
Move the {n} selected photos to the Recycle Bin?
This removes them from disk and from the library.
会话「{name}」有尚未保存的修改。\n是否在退出前保存当前会话工程？:
Session “{name}” has unsaved changes.
Save the session before leaving?
会话共记录 {total} 张底片，其中 {missing} 张在原存储路径未找:
This session lists {total} photos; {missing} of them are not at their original path.
If the folder was moved to another location or drive, point at it and the relink will cascade automatically.
Choose the folder with the photos…
